Chhath Puja 2026: bihar men sandhya arghy par umra aastha ka sailab, ghaton par dikha adbhut najara
Chhath mahaparv ke pahle arghy yani sandhya arghy par bihar ke ghaton par umra aastha ka jansailaba. dubte sury dev ko arghy dekar vratiyon ne parivar ki sukh-samriddhi aur khushhali ki kamna ki. dekhie ghaton ki raunak, khubsurat sajavat aur shraddhaluon ki aastha ki khas tasviren.
Watch the beautiful visuals of Chhath Puja 2026 with Prabhat Khabar.
Produced by: Sonam Singh
Edited by: Sumit Kumar Verma
